en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: And whatever is narrated from Thuwair ibn Abi Fakhtah, I have narrated it from my father and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with them - from Saʿd ibn Abdullah, from Al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq Al-Nahdi, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Malik ibn Aṭiyyah, from Thuwair ibn Abi Fakhtah,
whose father's name was Saʿid ibn ʿIlaqah.
